How do I get paid for bookings paid thro: How do I get paid for bookings paid through Trove?
By bank transfer from Serein Consultancy: By bank transfer from Serein Consultancy LLC, the company behind Trove,, so look for that name on your statement. Your fee — the price less the 10% platform fee — is provisional until the service date has passed and a 3-day window for any complaint or cancellation has closed; it is then paid on the next payout day, every other Tuesday, the same days Trove pays its makers. Add your bank details under Payouts in your dashboard; each fee there shows when it’s payable and, once sent, the date and the transfer reference.
